findings.suggested_fix: Split compound criteria, replace subjective terms with observable outcomes, and state how each is verified.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] State the compact-magnitude format for each component (e.g. description: char/line delta or just the name; children: added/removed id count) so every stale-material reason has a determinate, testable form.
evidence: The AC gives an example only for file_impact.
The happy-path testing bullet requires a description-only and children-only test but does not state what magnitude string each emits.
description is a text blob and children is an id set — the 'compact magnitude' notion needs a stated form for each so tests can assert on a determinate substring.
findings.finding: The AC requiring a 'compact magnitude' in the stale-material reason only defines the magnitude format for file_impact (`file_impact: 13 -> 16 paths`); the representation for a description-only or children-only change is unspecified.
findings.location: Acceptance Criteria: 'A `stale-material` reason ... NAMES the differing component(s) with a compact magnitude (for example `file_impact: 13 -> 16 paths`)'
scenarios: A description edit: the executor must invent a magnitude representation (char delta? line delta? just the name?) with no stated default.
A children edit: is the magnitude a count delta or the added/removed ids?
findings.suggested_fix: Specify per-component: `description` names itself (optionally a char-count delta), `children` reports added/removed ids or a count delta, `file_impact` reports the path-count delta as shown.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Add an acceptance criterion (e.g. a grep) asserting the attest_gate docstring lists not-closed, malformed-phase, incompatible-phase and the stale-pin-* verdicts.
evidence: The Scope list omits attest_gate.py's docstring change as a separately-verified item and the Acceptance Criteria contain no line proving the docstring now lists the full verdict set.
Every other Approach change (stale-material naming, stale-reopened, unsigned, sign_aborted, dependency naming, docs) has a covering AC; this one does not.
findings.finding: The docstring-vocabulary correction (attest_gate.py:166-167 — adding not-closed, malformed-phase, incompatible-phase, stale-pin-* to the documented verdict list) is a described deliverable in Approach step 5 with no covering acceptance criterion.
findings.location: Approach step 5, last bullet: 'attest_gate.py:166-167 — the docstring's verdict vocabulary omits ...'
scenarios: A reviewer marks the plan done with the docstring still stale because no AC forces verification of the corrected verdict list.
findings.suggested_fix: Add: '- [ ] The attest_gate verdict docstring lists every value compute_validity can return (including not-closed, malformed-phase, incompatible-phase, stale-pin-*); verified by a grep for those substrings.'

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Reconcile AC 3's repo-wide `src/` grep with the Scope: either add `_commands/transition_close.py:138` (the docstring literal) to the edit list or narrow the grep so it excludes non-reason docstring occurrences.
evidence: Plan: 'Surfaces deliberately left unchanged because they already forward the reason verbatim: _commands/gates.py::_claim_gate_reason, _commands/transition_close.py, and llm/code_review/bugfix_size_gate.py.'
Plan AC: '… does not contain the string description/AC/file_impact/children; verified by one test per component, plus a repo-wide grep asserting that literal no longer appears in src/.'

grep of the literal in src/rebar yields FOUR hits: generation.py:268, resign.py:205, attest.py:595 (all edited), and transition_close.py:138 — the last is in the 'left unchanged' bucket. transition_close.py:138 reads: 'fingerprint plan-review signs (description/AC/file_impact/children) — so completion'
findings.finding: The plan's inventory of sites carrying the literal string `description/AC/file_impact/children` is incomplete: it lists generation.py, resign.py, and attest.py as the fixed-list sites to reword, and places `_commands/transition_close.py` in the 'left unchanged' bucket, but transition_close.py:138 embeds that exact literal in a docstring. AC 3 requires 'a repo-wide grep asserting that literal no longer appears in src/', which will FAIL because transition_close.py:138 is not in the edit scope.
findings.location: Approach step 5 'Surfaces deliberately left unchanged … _commands/transition_close.py'; AC line 'does not contain the string description/AC/file_impact/children … a repo-wide grep asserting that literal no longer appears in src/'
scenarios: src/rebar/_commands/transition_close.py:138 — the docstring literal survives, so the AC's repo-wide `grep -R 'description/AC/file_impact/children' src/` still matches and the acceptance test fails.
The change under-delivers its stated intent ('naming an input that does not exist') because a reader of the completion close-gate docstring still sees the fictional 'AC' input.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `src/rebar/_commands/transition_close.py` (docstring at line 138) to the reworded-literal Scope, or scope AC 3's grep to reason-producing strings only rather than all of src/.
